---
name: provenance-check
description: Check Ventura APIs entries and copied examples for accurate provider attribution terms and license boundaries. Use when adding external API documentation snippets schemas or examples. Do not use when the change is only original repository commentary with no external material.
---

# Provenance check

- Identify each provider and canonical source affected by the change.
- Distinguish a link reference from copied or adapted documentation.
- Read `PROVENANCE.md` when present and keep it aligned.
- Preserve required attribution and license notices for copied material.
- Remove unsupported partnership certification or provider-affiliation implications.
- Prefer linking to provider docs over copying large sections.
